description.zh: 把词表示成一列数，用余弦衡量相似，用向量加减做类比，并从共现统计里学出向量。前三步用手工玩具特征，第四步是原始计数，不是真实训练。
description.en: Represent words as lists of numbers, measure similarity with cosine, solve analogies with vector arithmetic, and learn vectors from co-occurrence statistics. Early steps use hand-set toy features and step 4 uses raw counts, not real training.

reason.zh: 词向量把每个词放进向量空间，相似度用向量的点积和夹角衡量，类比用向量加减完成。
reason.en: Embeddings place each word in a vector space, with similarity measured by dot products and angles and analogies done by vector addition and subtraction.

reason.zh: 注意力对每个词的向量做查询、键、值运算，词向量是这些运算的起点；这里只说明衔接，不涉及训练细节。
reason.en: Attention computes queries, keys and values from each word's vector, so embeddings are the starting point; this edge only states the hand-off and says nothing about training details.

title.zh: 词怎样变成可计算的向量？
title.en: How does a word become a computable vector?
